entries.name: Hunter
entries: From an early age, some adventurers hear the call of the wild drawing them from the comfort of their homes into the unforgiving outdoors. Those who endure become hunters. These masters of their environment slip like ghosts through the trees and lay traps in their enemies' paths.

Many hunters have pets that attack while the hunters nock their arrows, fire their guns, or ready their polearms. Hunters are highly mobile, evading or restraining foes to control the arena of battle.
